title: Jamaican Jerk Chicken Fritters
description: A Caribbean-inspired snack with spicy jerk seasoning and crispy fried chicken fritters. Serve with a side of tangy mango salsa.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (180°C).
In a large bowl, mix together the chicken, flour, jerk seasoning, and a pinch of salt.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small balls and flatten them slightly into fritters.
Carefully place the fritters into the hot oil and fry for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
In a separate bowl, mix together the mango, red onion, lime juice, and crushed amaretti cookies.
To assemble the snack, place the fried fritters on a serving platter and spoon the mango salsa over the top.
Note: You can also bake the fritters in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 12-15 minutes, or until cooked through.
For an extra crispy coating, sprinkle the fritters with crushed amaretti cookies before serving.
